sections.heading: SPECIALIZATION IN GEOLOGY – For Professional Registration
lines: This module is designed to meet the minimum geoscience knowledge requirements for Professional Registration as a licensed geoscientist in Canada as set by the Association of Professional Geoscientists of Ontario (APGO) and the Canadian Council of Professional Geoscientists (CCPG).
Completion of Western’s first year requirements.
0.5 course from: Physics 1101A/B, Physics 1201A/B, Physics 1401A/B, Physics 1501A/B.
1.0 course from: Chemistry 1302A/B, one of (Physics 1102A/B, Physics 1202A/B, Physics 1402A/B, Physics 1502A/B), one of (Biology 1001A, Biology 1002B).
0.5 course from: Calculus 1000A/B, Calculus 1500A/B, Mathematics 1225A/B, Numerical and Mathematical Methods 1412A/B.
0.5 course from: Any 1000-level course offered by the Faculty of Science and not already taken.

6.0 courses from: Earth Sciences 2200A/B, Earth Sciences 2201A/B, Earth Sciences 2206A/B, Earth Sciences 2220A/B, Earth Sciences 2230A/B, Earth Sciences 2250Y, Earth Sciences 2260A/B, Earth Sciences 2265A/B, Earth Sciences 3314A/B, Earth Sciences 3316A/B, Earth Sciences 3350Y, Earth Sciences 4321A/B, the former Earth Sciences 3313A/B, the former Earth Sciences 3315A/B, the former Earth Sciences 3321A/B.
0.5 course from: Earth Sciences 4460A/B, Earth Sciences 4462A/B, Geography and Environment 2220A/B.

2.5 courses from: Earth Sciences 3310A/B, Earth Sciences 3340A/B, Earth Sciences 3341A/B, Earth Sciences 3370A/B, Earth Sciences 3372A/B, Earth Sciences 4431A/B, Earth Sciences 4432A/B, Earth Sciences 4440A/B, Earth Sciences 4450Y or Earth Sciences 4451Z, Earth Sciences 4472A/B.
